author: Veritas I
title: Multi-Head Additive Attention CNN-BiLSTM for RNA Modeling
abstract: This submission introduces a Multi-Head Additive Attention Pooling mechanism into the CNN-BiLSTM hybrid architecture. After the 1D CNN for local feature extraction and the BiLSTM for sequential dependencies, multiple independent additive attention heads are applied to the BiLSTM output. The concatenated context vectors from these heads provide a richer, multi-faceted sequence summary, aiming to capture diverse salient features and achieve more robust and higher performance across all seven RNA prediction tasks.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
from typing import Any, Dict

# Single Additive Attention Head module
class SingleHeadAdditiveAttention(nn.Module):
    dense_attn_units: int # Hidden units for the attention scoring mechanism
    head_name: str # Unique name for this head

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # x shape: (batch_size, seq_len, input_features)
        
        # Compute attention scores
        attention_logits = nn.Dense(features=self.dense_attn_units, name=f"{self.head_name}_dense_1")(x)
        attention_logits = nn.tanh(attention_logits)
        
        attention_logits = nn.Dense(features=1, name=f"{self.head_name}_dense_2")(attention_logits) # (batch, seq_len, 1)

        # Apply softmax to get attention weights
        attention_weights = nn.softmax(attention_logits, axis=1) # (batch, seq_len, 1)

        # Apply attention weights to original sequence and sum
        pooled_output = jnp.sum(x * attention_weights, axis=1) # (batch, input_features)
        
        return pooled_output

# Multi-Head Additive Attention Pooling module
class MultiHeadAdditiveAttentionPooling(nn.Module):
    num_attention_heads: int
    attention_head_units: int # Hidden units for each attention head's scoring

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # x shape: (batch_size, seq_len, input_features)
        
        head_outputs = []
        for i in range(self.num_attention_heads):
            head_output = SingleHeadAdditiveAttention(
                dense_attn_units=self.attention_head_units,
                head_name=f"attention_head_{i}"
            )(x)
            head_outputs.append(head_output)
        
        # Concatenate outputs from all heads
        # (batch, num_attention_heads * input_features)
        return jnp.concatenate(head_outputs, axis=-1)

# Main network class
class AttentionCNNBiLSTMNetwork_V3(nn.Module):
    d_input: int = 4
    d_output: int = 1
    task_type: str = "regression"
    conv_features: int = 192
    kernel_size: int = 9
    lstm_hidden_dim: int = 384
    num_attention_heads: int = 4 # NEW
    attention_head_units: int = 128 # NEW (internal dense units for each head)
    dense_dim_1: int = 512 # First dense layer after pooling
    dense_dim_2: int = 256 # Second dense layer
    dropout_rate: float = 0.2

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch, seq_len, d_input)
        
        # 1. CNN Layer for local feature extraction
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.conv_features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,))(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 2. Bidirectional LSTM Layer for long-range dependency modeling
        fwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='fwd_lstm')
        fwd_lstm_output = fwd_lstm(x)
        fwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(fwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)

        x_reversed = jnp.flip(x, axis=1)
        bwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='bwd_lstm')
        bwd_lstm_output = bwd_lstm(x_reversed)
        bwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(bwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)
        bwd_lstm_output = jnp.flip(bwd_lstm_output, axis=1)

        x = jnp.concatenate([fwd_lstm_output, bwd_lstm_output], axis=-1) # (batch, new_seq_len, 2 * lstm_hidden_dim)
        
        # 3. Multi-Head Additive Attention Pooling to get fixed-size representation
        x = MultiHeadAdditiveAttentionPooling(
            num_attention_heads=self.num_attention_heads,
            attention_head_units=self.attention_head_units
        )(x) # (batch, num_attention_heads * 2 * lstm_hidden_dim)
        
        # 4. Dense Layers
        x = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim_1)(x) # (batch, dense_dim_1)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        x = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim_2)(x) # (batch, dense_dim_2)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 5. Output layer
        if self.task_type == "regression":
            x = nn.Dense(1)(x) # (batch, 1)
            return x.squeeze(-1) # (batch,)
        else:
            x = nn.Dense(self.d_output)(x) # (batch, d_output)
            return x

# Hyperparameter definition
def _define_hyperparameters():
    """Define hyperparameters for the Multi-Head Additive Attention CNN-BiLSTM model."""
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'conv_features': 192,
        'kernel_size': 9,
        'lstm_hidden_dim': 384,
        'num_attention_heads': 4, # NEW
        'attention_head_units': 128, # NEW
        'dense_dim_1': 1024, # Adjusted for increased input from concatenated attention heads (4 * 2 * 384 = 3072 features if lstm_hidden_dim is 384, so 1024 is reasonable)
        'dense_dim_2': 512, # Adjusted
        'dropout_rate': 0.2,
    }

class CustomRNANetwork_MultiHeadAttention:
    """Custom network wrapper for Hybrid CNN-BiLSTM with Multi-Head Additive Attention."""

    def __init__(self, d_input=4, d_output=1, task_type="regression",
                 conv_features=192, kernel_size=9,
                 lstm_hidden_dim=384, num_attention_heads=4, attention_head_units=128,
                 dense_dim_1=1024, dense_dim_2=512, dropout_rate=0.2):
        self.network = AttentionCNNBiLSTMNetwork_V3(
            d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
            conv_features=conv_features, kernel_size=kernel_size,
            lstm_hidden_dim=lstm_hidden_dim, num_attention_heads=num_attention_heads,
            attention_head_units=attention_head_units,
            dense_dim_1=dense_dim_1, dense_dim_2=dense_dim_2, dropout_rate=dropout_rate
        )

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0) 
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False,
                                    rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    d_output = hparams.get("d_output", 1)
    task_type = hparams.get("task_type", "regression")
    conv_features = hparams.get("conv_features", 192)
    kernel_size = hparams.get("kernel_size", 9)
    lstm_hidden_dim = hparams.get("lstm_hidden_dim", 384)
    num_attention_heads = hparams.get("num_attention_heads", 4)
    attention_head_units = hparams.get("attention_head_units", 128)
    dense_dim_1 = hparams.get("dense_dim_1", 1024)
    dense_dim_2 = hparams.get("dense_dim_2", 512)
    dropout_rate = hparams.get("dropout_rate", 0.2)

    d_input = 4 # All datasets use 4-channel input (one-hot RNA)

    return CustomRNANetwork_MultiHeadAttention(
        d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
        conv_features=conv_features, kernel_size=kernel_size,
        lstm_hidden_dim=lstm_hidden_dim, num_attention_heads=num_attention_heads,
        attention_head_units=attention_head_units,
        dense_dim_1=dense_dim_1, dense_dim_2=dense_dim_2, dropout_rate=dropout_rate
    )
